description: This file defines the CsrfDefenseStrategy class implementing CSRF protection logic, including token generation, request validation, and response handling within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: Implements CSRF defense strategies including token generation, validation, and response handling.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a random CSRF token string using SecureRandom.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Determines the maximum subfolder depth for token map lookup based on request URI.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Decides whether to modify or check the CSRF token based on request URI and token value.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Determines if the CSRF token should be retained after a request, especially for GET requests.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Handles invalid or missing CSRF tokens by setting error message and throwing exception.
